name: eino-viewer
description: See one real Eino run from input through observed steps to output or failure.

scripts.build: npm run build:es && npm run build:cjs
scripts.check: node --check src/protocol-core.js && node --check src/component-protocol.js && node --check src/run-record-v2.js && node --check src/viewer-v2.js && node --check src/run-viewer-v2.js && node --check src/versioned-viewer.js && node --check src/run-record.js && node --check src/run-lifecycle.js && node --check src/views.js && node --check src/viewer.js && node --check src/execution-dag.js && node --check src/trajectory.js && node --check src/explanation.js && node --check src/scope-reading.js && node --check src/content-presentation.js && node --check src/renderer-presentation.js && node --check src/json-value.js && node --check src/record-input.js && node --check src/run-viewer.js && node --check site/app.js && npm run check:reading
scripts.check:reading: node --check src/reading-presentation.js && node --check src/run-viewer-state.js && node --check src/run-viewer-styles.js && node --check src/viewer-state.js && node --check src/rendered-value-fold.js && node --check src/trajectory-reading.js && node --check src/agent-run-viewer.js && node --check src/agent-run-viewer-styles.js && node --check site/agent-reader.js && node --check site/graph-reading.js && node --check site/graph-topology.js && node --check site/graph-topology-view.js
scripts.test: node tests/component-protocol.test.js && node tests/run-record.test.js && node tests/recorder-matrix.test.js && node tests/complex-graph-workflow.test.js && node tests/views.test.js && node tests/viewer.test.js && node tests/viewer-v2.test.js && node tests/domain-views.test.js && node tests/negative-domains.test.js && node tests/execution-dag.test.js && node tests/trajectory.test.js && node tests/trajectory-reading.test.js && node tests/explanation.test.js && node tests/inspection.test.js && node tests/scope-reading.test.js && node tests/renderer-presentation.test.js && node tests/reading-presentation.test.js && node tests/graph-reading.test.js && node tests/graph-topology.test.js && node tests/rendered-value-fold.test.js && node tests/content-presentation.test.js && node tests/run-viewer.test.js && node tests/json-input-boundary.test.js && node tests/record-input.test.js && npm run test:protocol-v2
scripts.test:recorder-matrix: npm run test:recorder-matrix:go && node tests/recorder-matrix.test.js && node tests/complex-graph-workflow.test.js && npm run inspect:recorder-matrix
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.typecheck:protocol-v2: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck false --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler tests/protocol-v2-types.test.ts
scripts.test:protocol-v2: node --test tests/protocol-v2.test.js tests/protocol-v2-review.test.js && npm run typecheck:protocol-v2
scripts.test:protocol-v2:all: npm run check:protocol-v2-types && npm run check:protocol-v2-validator && npm run test:protocol-v2 && npm run test:protocol-v2:go && node scripts/check-protocol-v2-roundtrip.js && npm run test:protocol-v2:recorders
